originalTitle: Ipswich Town 0-2 Liverpool: Premier League – as it happened
summary: Minute-by-minute report: Alexander Isak’s early quick-fire double gave Andoni Iraola his first win as Liverpool manager. Scott Murray was watching
content: John Brewin was our man in Suffolk tonight, and his verdict has landed. Here it is! Thanks for reading this MBM. Gary O’Neil talks to Sky Sports. “Proud of the group … I thought we were excellent … two mistakes in the first ten minutes made it very difficult … but then we were probably the better side for large parts after that … more shots … I spoke about the setbacks at Manchester United and needing to respond to them better, and we did that very well … of course we don’t take any points … but a lot of good signs … a really good performance to go toe-to-toe with them in the way we did … very pleased … the mistakes were big and we were punished heavily by world-class players … an excellent response … we gave our best … but we are here for points and we need to make sure that next week we take some … second half we cut through them many times … didn’t quite find that moment of quality to get us back in it … this is one of our most extreme tests … we’re in a good spot.” Post-match postbag. “A relief to see Alexander Isak playing the way he did for Newcastle. And delighted Liverpool managed to hold on to Cody Gakpo who, besides being a talented forward, is a close pal of Virgil van Dijk which helps to cement the team in terms of relationships. Also glad to see Iraola bring on Nyoni. Hopefully, together with the expensive new signings, Liverpool will use their academy players more like Nyoni and the promising Danns” – Colum Fordham “I’m beginning to think Fulham must have sold Ipswich a ringer rather than Sasa Lukic - he hasn’t had his obligatory yellow card. It must be the pastoral idyll of Suffolk working its magic!” – Richard Hirst “When Jan Molby dragged himself up the field to take a penalty, his scoring record was one of the best. Mike Dean also loved a penalty” – Andrew Goudie Coming up next … Ipswich travel to Crystal Palace in the Premier League a week on Saturday, while Liverpool host Atletico Madrid in the Champions League on Wednesday night, before welcoming Fulham to Anfield in the league on Saturday. Andoni Iraola is congratulated by Sky’s Kelly Cates on his first win as Liverpool boss. “It is nice … we needed this one … we had a clean sheet … controlling the game quite well … we started strong … the second half was not as good as the first one … we did not concede clear chances … [Alexander Isak] is a massive player for us … probably my demands will not be about the goals … he’s going to produce the numbers … my fights with him [Iraola smiles cheekily] are more about other stuff … how to help the team … he has already played a very good amount of minutes … today we were much better in our press … we can give our number nine chances … for every centre-back to play next to Virgil [van Dijk] is a masterclass, a lesson … Jeremy [Jacquet] has played his first full game … the first two games he could not finish because he was tired … today there was a moment in the second half I was in doubt … but he has to suffer … he finished the game well … and he will build the fitness … we have good options [in midfield] … I think [Bradley Barcola] has had some very good minutes … it’s good to have him already going.” Player-of-the-match Alexander Isak talks to Sky Sports about his two-goal haul. “We was waiting for the first win … we were talking about starting the game good, which we haven’t done recently … so that was perfect for us to get two quick goals … we are starting to get the play we want to play … be offensive … we could have scored more … [the travails of last season] was not easy … obviously a long injury … a difficult season in general … I was thinking to have a good World Cup then start off this season well … which I feel like I’ve done now … that’s kind of behind me but it wasn’t easy … [Cody Gakpo] has done amazingly in assisting me … finding me in those situations … good positions where I enjoy having the ball … we have so much threat up front … all of us will enjoy our offensive game … it is still early … we still have a lot to learn … game by game … the support was unreal today and very much appreciated.” Liverpool’s first win of the season fetches them up to fifth spot. They won’t still be there by the time the third round of matches are complete, of course, but it’s nevertheless a welcome step in the right direction. Ipswich, given their testing early fixtures, should be happy enough with their return so far. Virgil van Dijk speaks to Sky Sports … “It was a good performance … great goals … Cody outstanding … onto the next … [Gakpo] is important for us … he will be important this season … he showed it today again … last week as well … and the last couple of years … [Isak] is getting up to speed now … he is going to show that with a Liverpool shirt … we recover and focus on the Champions League.” … as does Cody Gakpo. “It was a great game … some things we have to improve still … a much-needed win for us … very happy that we got the three points … happy with the performance … hopefully we [Gakpo and Isak] can assist each other many times … he owes me a few assists now! … hopefully beautiful things are ahead … outstanding support as always.” Andoni Iraola wears a wide smile as he congratulates his two-goal hero Alexander Isak. He’s up and running as Liverpool boss. But both teams have something to take away from that. Liverpool obviously, with the three points that get their Premier League campaign properly going. Alexander Isak, too, with his first double for Liverpool, already on three goals for the season. He’s shoved towards the travelling fans by Cody Gakpo, who assisted him twice, so he can get his flowers. But Ipswich and Gary O’Neil will be pleased too, when it all comes down, with the way they responded to conceding two quickfire goals early in the match. They battled well for the remaining 80-odd minutes, and though they didn’t really get much going in the final third, will be pleased with their overall performance and general display of moxie. chineseTitle: 伊普斯维奇镇 0-2 利物浦：英超联赛——事实如此
chineseSummary: 每分钟报道：亚历山大·伊萨克早期的快速梅开二度为安多尼·伊劳拉带来了他作为利物浦主教练的第一场胜利。斯科特·穆雷正在观看
chineseContent: 约翰·布鲁温是我们今晚在萨福克的人，他的判决已经下达。这里是！感谢您阅读本 MBM。加里·奥尼尔接受天空体育采访。 “为球队感到骄傲……我认为我们很出色……前十分钟的两个错误让比赛变得非常困难……但在那之后我们可能在大部分比赛中表现更好……更多的射门……我谈到了曼联的挫折，需要更好地应对它们，我们做得很好……当然我们没有得到任何分数……但有很多好的迹象……以我们的方式与他们面对面的表现非常好……非常高兴……错误很大，我们受到世界级球员的严厉惩罚……反应出色……我们尽力了……但我们来这里是为了积分，我们需要确保下周我们能取得一些成绩……下半场我们多次突破……没有找到让我们重新回到比赛状态的高质量时刻……这是我们最极端的考验之一……我们处于一个很好的位置。”赛后邮袋。 “看到亚历山大·伊萨克像他在纽卡斯尔那样踢球，我感到很欣慰。很高兴利物浦能够留住科迪·加克波，他不仅是一名才华横溢的前锋，还是维吉尔·范迪克的好朋友，这有助于巩固球队的关系。也很高兴看到伊劳拉引进尼奥尼。希望，加上昂贵的新签约，利物浦将更多地使用他们的青训球员，就像尼奥尼和有前途的丹斯一样”——科勒姆·福特汉姆“我开始思考富勒姆一定是卖给了伊普斯维奇，而不是萨萨·卢基奇——他还没有得到他的强制性黄牌，这一定是萨福克的田园诗发挥了魔力！” – 理查德·赫斯特 “当简·莫尔比拖着自己上场主罚点球时，他的得分记录是最好的之一。迈克·迪恩也喜欢点球” – An
